description: A vulnerability was detected in Kamailio up to 6.0.7/6.1.3. The affected element is the function isup_get_calling_party of the file src/modules/sipt/ss7_parser.c of the component sipt Module. The manipulation of the argument length results in buffer overflow. The attack may be performed from remote. Upgrading to version 6.0.8 and 6.1.4 is sufficient to fix this issue. The patch is identified as 3667bebf8d0bea07ed16218fd921d07db87aeb21. Upgrading the affected component is advised.

A security vulnerability has been detected in Tencent WeKnora up to 0.8.1. Impacted is the function validateSubquery of the file internal/utils/inject.go of the component SQL Validator. The manipulation leads to sql injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. Upgrading to version 0.8.2 is recommended to address this issue. The identifier of the patch is d7ccd5ba517cc3968e6d5000a2ab0f4b51ef1dda. It is recommended to upgrade the affected component.

A weakness has been identified in agno-agi agno up to 3.0.6/3.1.1. This issue affects the function member_agent.run in the library libs/agno/agno/team/_default_tools.py of the component Delegation Feature. Executing a manipulation can lead to execution with unnecessary privileges. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The pull request to fix this issue awaits acceptance.

A SQL Injection (SQLi) affects the Kong Gateway (Enterprise and Open Source) clustering communication logic when operating in Hybrid Mode. The issue can be triggered by sending specially crafted RPC requests to the Control Plane (CP), leading to potential unauthorized database access. Leveraging the issue requires network access to the Control Plane’s clustering port and a valid client certificate and key.

A vulnerability was identified in agno-agi agno up to 2.7.3/3.0.6. This affects the function get_authentication_dependency of the file auth.py. Such manipulation of the argument security_key leads to missing authentication. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

A vulnerability was determined in agno-agi agno up to 3.0.9. Affected by this issue is the function agno.CodingTools.run_shell in the library libs/agno/agno/tools/coding.py of the component CodingTools. This manipulation of the argument command causes os command injection. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. Upgrading to version 3.0.10 can resolve this issue. Patch name: ed64fab5be63d2b15faddc2ef7c733176daa14aa. You should upgrade the affected component.

A vulnerability was found in agno-agi agno up to 3.0.6. Affected by this vulnerability is the function run_python_code of the file python.py of the component PythonTools. The manipulation of the argument code results in code injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

A vulnerability has been found in idcCMS 1.70. Affected is an unknown function of the file admin/member_deal.php. The manipulation leads to cross site scripting. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in DLX Plugins Custom Query Blocks post-type-archive-mapping allows Stored XSS.This issue affects Custom Query Blocks: from n/a through 5.6.0.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in WP Desk Flexible Subscriptions flexible-subscriptions allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Flexible Subscriptions: from n/a through 1.8.4.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Crocoblock JetElements For Elementor jet-elements allows Stored XSS.This issue affects JetElements For Elementor: from n/a through 2.9.2.3.
Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Crocoblock JetMenu jet-menu allows Stored XSS.This issue affects JetMenu: from n/a through 3.0.5.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Igor Funa Ad Inserter ad-inserter allows Stored XSS.This issue affects Ad Inserter: from n/a through 2.8.18.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in Codection Products Restricted Users for WooCommerce woo-products-restricted-users allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Products Restricted Users for WooCommerce: from n/a through 0.7.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in WP User Manager WP User Manager wp-user-manager allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects WP User Manager: from n/a through 2.9.22.
Rejected reason: Duplicate of CVE-2026-71364, which was publicly disclosed and fixed in Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform on 2026-08-24. No separate identifier is required.

Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Sent Data vulnerability in Pluggabl LLC. Booster Elite for WooCommerce booster-elite-for-woocommerce allows Retrieve Embedded Sensitive Data.This issue affects Booster Elite for WooCommerce: from n/a before 8.4.0.

A security flaw has been discovered in agno-agi agno up to 3.0.6/3.1.1. This vulnerability affects the function exec of the component Agent Orchestration Layer. Performing a manipulation of the argument code results in dynamically-managed code resources. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The pull request to fix this issue awaits acceptance.

Rejected reason: ** REJECT ** DO NOT USE THIS CANDIDATE NUMBER. Reason: This candidate was issued in error. Notes: All references and descriptions in this candidate have been removed to prevent accidental usage.

A flaw has been found in SEMCMS up to 5.0. This impacts an unknown function of the file SEMCMS_Banner.php. Executing a manipulation can lead to sql injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A vulnerability was detected in SEMCMS up to 5.0. This affects an unknown function of the file SEMCMS_Download.php. Performing a manipulation results in sql injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A security vulnerability has been detected in SEMCMS up to 5.0. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file /admin/SEMCMS_User.php?Class=Deleted&CF=user. Such manipulation leads to improper authorization. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A weakness has been identified in WMCMS 4.446.1257. The affected element is an unknown function of the file /index.php. This manipulation of the argument path/file causes information disclosure. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks.

A security flaw has been discovered in tsi-coop tsi-dpdp-cms 0.5.0/0.5.1/0.5.2. Impacted is an unknown function of the component JSON Schema Validation. The manipulation of the argument _func results in information disclosure. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. Upgrading to version 0.5.3 is recommended to address this issue. You should upgrade the affected component. The vendor was contacted early, responded in a very professional manner and quickly released a fixed version of the affected product.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in NOUS Ouvert Utile et Simple Event post event-post allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Event post: from n/a through 6.1.1.
